Online Learning (OL) Programs

Pursue 100% online learning (OL) degrees featuring virtual classes, digital e-content, remote proctored examinations, and global networking opportunities.

Represented OL Courses

Online Mode (OL) 2 Years

Master of Business Administration (Online MBA)

  • 100% online delivery: virtual classes, webinars, digital assignments.
  • Global curriculum with live interactive mentorship from top faculty.
  • Fully digital examination structure (anywhere online).
Careers: Enterprise Consultant, Strategy Analyst, Product Manager.
Online Mode (OL) 2 Years

Master of Computer Applications (Online MCA)

  • 100% online learning: e-classes, digital assignments, online labs.
  • Covers modern domains: Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing.
  • Remote online examinations (secure digital proctoring).
Careers: Cloud architect, Solutions Engineer, Data Specialist.
Online Mode (OL) 3 Years

Bachelor of Business Administration (Online BBA)

  • Advanced online study materials & interactive assignments.
  • Digital assessments & continuous performance feedback modules.
  • Ideal for working professionals seeking early-career management growth.
Careers: Sales Representative, Business Analyst, HR Executive.
Online Mode (OL) 3 Years

Bachelor of Computer Applications (Online BCA)

  • Online interactive modules in UI/UX, Javascript frameworks, Databases.
  • Continuous digital assessments and flexible assignment cycles.
  • Perfect for IT aspirants wanting absolute location independence.
Careers: UI Developer, Systems Admin, App Developer.
Online Mode (OL) 3 Years

Bachelor of Arts (Online B.A.)

  • Interactive online lectures, structured e-books, self-assessments.
  • Ideal for candidates wanting to balance work with general studies degrees.
  • Completely remote digital examination structure.
Careers: Executive Assistant, Writer, NGO Coordinator.
Online Mode (OL) 2 Years

Master of Arts in English (Online M.A. English)

  • Focus areas: British Literature, American Literature, Literary Theory.
  • 100% online mode: online web sessions, digital content portal.
  • Remote proctored digital exams for absolute flexibility.
Careers: Educator, Copywriter, Editor, Researcher.
Online Mode (OL) 2 Years

Master of Arts in Journalism & Mass Comm (Online MAJMC)

  • Modern curriculum: Social Media Management, Digital Ad Operations, SEO.
  • Online webinars, digital projects, and interactive forum sessions.
  • Fully remote online testing.
Careers: Social Media Strategist, Digital Reporter, Content Lead.
Online Mode (OL) 2 Years

Master of Science in Mathematics (Online M.Sc. Math)

  • 100% online mode: live seminars, query forums, digital assignments.
  • Offers complete flexibility to complete coursework on a secure online portal.
  • Remote proctored digital examinations.
Careers: Quantitative Analyst, Risk Manager, Mathematics Lecturer.
